data.title: Arm CEO Rene Haas Reportedly Approached By Recruitment Agency Hired By Nvidia Board
data.description:
Key points:
  • Recruitment firm Heidrick & Struggles, hired by Nvidia’s board, has reached out to Haas. 
  • Haas brings previous experience from Nvidia—having served seven years as general manager of computing products.
  • Harvey Jones, chairman of Nvidia's board of directors, confirmed during the Q3 earnings call that Jensen Huang would not be reinstated as CEO.

A recruitment agency hired by Nvidia’s (NVDA) board has reportedly officially reached out to Arm Holdings (ARM) CEO Rene Haas to take over the reins at the chipmaker since Jensen Huang’s exit.

Huang's abrupt exit came after revelations regarding an extramarital affair with a woman who had been investigated by the U.S. government for alleged espionage on behalf of China, an allegation that Beijing has denied.

NVDA share price ended Wednesday nearly 3% lower, down for the fifth consecutive session.

A Familiar Face

Haas previously spent seven years at Nvidia as the general manager of computing products before taking the helm at Arm. Furthermore, the two companies share corporate history, having pursued a blockbuster merger in 2020 that ultimately collapsed under intense regulatory scrutiny.

Earlier this week, Nvidia's board chairman firmly stated during the earnings call that Jensen Huang will not be reinstated under any circumstances, making a permanent external or industry-veteran appointment essential for the company's future.

Speaking publicly about the shake-up at a technology conference in Austin, Haas commended his former boss's monumental contributions to the sector. "What he (Huang) built at Nvidia is historic," Haas remarked during the event. "You don't have many champions like that".

Congressional Investigations Into Nvidia

Representative Brett Guthrie, chairman of the House Committee on Energy and Commerce, sent a letter to Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress on Wednesday requesting company officials appear before the panel no later than December. 2.

The committee is investigating whether Nvidia bypassed federal restrictions designed to keep advanced artificial intelligence technology out of China, as well as whether a top company official attempted to interfere with a federal inquiry.

NVDA Stock: Retail View 

Retail sentiment on Nvidia stock has remained in the ‘extremely bullish’ zone, along with ‘extremely high’ retail investor engagement on Stocktwits over the past several weeks.

NVDA stock has lost about 19.6% year-to-date.

data.title: Elevate Uranium Advances Namibian Projects and U-pgrade Process Amid Resource Expansion
data.description:
Elevate Uranium is an Australian company focused on the exploration and development of uranium projects, with a significant emphasis on its assets in Namibia and its proprietary U-pgrade™ beneficiation process.

The company recently provided updates on its operational progress and strategic interests, highlighting its efforts to advance its project pipeline and resource base.

Elevate Uranium's strategy centres on defining and expanding its uranium resources and progressing its U-pgrade™ process, designed to beneficiate uranium ore.

While the company holds a broad portfolio of uranium projects in Australia, its principal development focus is Namibia, particularly the Koppies and Marenica projects.

Developing Namibian Uranium Assets

The company's Namibian portfolio includes the 100%-owned Koppies Uranium Project, which comprises the Koppies, Hirabeb, and Namib IV resources. Koppies hosts a JORC 2012 Mineral Resource of 76.2 Mlb U3O8.

Elevate Uranium also holds a substantial interest in the Marenica Uranium Project. In a recent update on October 30, 2026, the company announced the completion of an acquisition to increase its ownership in Marenica Minerals, which owns the Marenica Uranium Project, from 75% to 90%.

This transaction enhances Elevate Uranium's attributable share of Marenica's JORC resource to 47.5 Mlb U3O8 from a gross resource of 52.8 Mlb U3O8. Following this, Elevate Uranium stated its attributable Namibian resource base stands at 124 Mlb U3O8, with global resources totalling 181 Mlb U3O8.

Management indicated that the increased interest in Marenica complements the Koppies Project, supporting a district-scale development case for its U-pgrade™ beneficiation process within Namibia's Erongo Region.

Advancing U-pgrade Beneficiation Process

A key component of Elevate Uranium's strategy is its patented U-pgrade™ beneficiation process, which aims to reject gangue material before the leaching stage, potentially reducing the mass of material requiring downstream processing.

In its September 2026 Quarterly Activities Report, released on October 29, 2026, Elevate Uranium reported encouraging pilot-scale results for Stages 1 to 4 of the U-pgrade™ process using Marenica ore. These stages achieved a cumulative mass rejection of approximately 88% of the original ore mass and upgraded the Marenica ore approximately seven times, from a head grade of 89 ppm U to 590 ppm U. The company also reported a uranium recovery of 79% through Stages 1 to 4, which it noted was in line with expectations for the low-grade feed.

A significant outcome from Stage 4 calcite flotation was its role in enabling a simpler acid leach route at ambient temperature, with an estimated four to six-hour residence time. This contrasts with conventional alkaline leaching, which typically requires temperatures greater than 92 degrees Celsius for 24 to 36 hours. The company estimates this could substantially reduce the required leach circuit volume.

Looking ahead, Stage 5 uranium flotation was commissioned in August 2026, with integrated five-stage results targeted for the December 2026 quarter. Elevate Uranium plans a further Marenica pilot campaign using resource-grade ore in the December 2026 quarter. Management intends to incorporate these pilot results into a Marenica Scoping Study, which is scheduled to commence in the March 2027 quarter. The company also plans to test Koppies ore through the U-pgrade™plant in the same quarter.

Exploration Progress and Funding

During the September 2026 quarter, Elevate Uranium continued its drilling programs.

At the Marenica Project, 718 holes were drilled for 31,115 metres, primarily infill drilling intended to support the conversion of Inferred resources to Indicated resources, with an updated resource estimate planned for the next quarter.

Drilling at the Koppies Namib IV resource area totalled 191 holes for 5,408 metres, targeting resource infill and extensions.

The company reported cash holdings of A$22.2 million at the end of the September 2026 quarter, providing funding for its ongoing exploration and pilot plant activities.

Uranium in the Global Energy Transition

The global landscape for uranium, a strategic energy commodity, continues to draw attention as countries increasingly consider nuclear energy as a key component of their clean energy strategies.

Nuclear power offers a low-carbon baseload electricity source, which is seen as vital for achieving decarbonisation goals and ensuring energy security.

This broader context of energy transition and the demand for critical minerals underpins the strategic significance of uranium exploration and development companies like Elevate Uranium.

Looking Forward

Elevate Uranium continues to focus on developing its substantial uranium resource base in Namibia and advancing its patented U-pgrade™ beneficiation process.

The company's recent increase in Marenica ownership and ongoing pilot plant results underscore its strategy to progress its projects towards potential studies, while exploration efforts aim to enhance resource confidence across its portfolio.

data.title: Bankrupt Dish Wireless reaches $525M settlement with American Tower - report
data.description:
EchoStar subsidiary Dish Wireless has reached a $525M settlement with American Tower and is in talks with other tower owners who say they're owed billions of dollars after its failed attempt to build a 5G network, according to a media report on Wednesday.

Dish is in the process of hammering out similar deals with other large creditors, including Charter Communications , which provided infrastructure and services for its 5G network, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing a court hearing.

Last year, EchoStar switched strategy and started selling spectrum licenses and winding down the 5G network operations after the Federal Communications Commission pressured Dish for taking too long to build the network.

The settlement funds are being paid from a $2.4B creditor trust established by the FCC using proceeds from AT&T's purchase of EchoStar's spectrum licenses. The settlement with American Tower will require FCC approval, the WSJ said.

Dish Wireless, the EchoStar unit that was building the 5G network, filed for Chapter 11 in June along with Dish DBS, another EchoStar subsidiary, so they could restructure their balance sheets.

data.title: Patrick Industries Shareholders and LCI Industries Stockholders Overwhelmingly Approve All-Stock Merger
data.description:
Patrick Industries, Inc. () (“Patrick”) and LCI Industries () (“LCI” or “Lippert”) today announced that their shareholders and stockholders, respectively, have approved the proposals necessary to complete the companies’ previously announced all-stock merger.

“Today marks a significant milestone toward bringing Patrick and Lippert together, and we are grateful for the tremendous support from each company’s shareholders,” said Andy Nemeth, Chief Executive Officer of Patrick. “Our two companies share a deep commitment to our team members, customers and stakeholders, and we believe that together we can deliver more cost-effective, innovative solutions across the Outdoor Enthusiast, Housing and Transportation markets.”

“We appreciate the overwhelming support shown at both meetings today, and we are deeply grateful to the team members who work hard every day in service of our customers,” said Johnny Sirpilla, Interim Chief Executive Officer of Lippert. “For decades, Lippert has earned the trust of customers through innovation, reliability and a culture of service, the same values that have contributed to Patrick’s own growth. We are confident that merging the two companies will extend each company’s legacy in a meaningful way, benefiting team members, shareholders, and the community that we are both proud to call home.”

At the special meeting of Patrick shareholders held today, at least 97% of the votes cast, representing approximately 93% of all outstanding shares, were voted in favor of the four proposals related to the merger. At the special meeting of LCI stockholders held today, approximately 98% of the votes cast, representing approximately 82% of all outstanding shares, were voted in favor of the necessary proposal related to the merger.

The voting results for each special meeting will be reported in Current Reports on Form 8-K to be filed by Patrick and LCI, respectively, with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”). The transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027 and remains subject to the receipt of required regulatory approvals and the satisfaction or waiver of other customary closing conditions.

Additional information about the transaction is available at patrickandlipperttogether.com.

About Patrick Industries, Inc.

Patrick () is a leading component solutions provider serving original equipment manufacturers and aftermarket customers in the RV, Marine, Powersports and Housing markets. Since 1959, Patrick has empowered manufacturers and outdoor enthusiasts to achieve next-level recreation experiences. Our customer-focused approach brings together design, manufacturing, distribution, and transportation in a full solutions model that defines us as a trusted partner. Patrick is home to more than 85 leading brands, all united by a commitment to quality, customer service, and innovation. Headquartered in Elkhart, IN, Patrick employs approximately 10,000 skilled team members throughout the United States. For more information on Patrick, our brands, and products, please visit www.patrickind.com.

About LCI Industries

LCI Industries (), through its Lippert subsidiary, is a global leader in supplying engineered components to the outdoor recreation and transportation markets. We believe our innovative culture, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and dedication to enhancing the customer experience have established Lippert as a reliable partner for both OEM and aftermarket customers. data.title: U.S. Stocks Mixed, Nvidia Down Again Ahead of Anthropic IPO — Update
data.description:
By Rob Curran

U.S. stocks were mixed ahead of Anthropic's initial public offering as Nvidia's efforts to draw to a close to questions around exit of its former leader Jensen Huang failed to stabilize its stock or quell fears about its "neocloud" customers.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 561.25 points, or 1.11%, to 50198.17. The broad S&P 500 slipped 16.90 points, or 0.23%, to 7323.63, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite gained 101.50 points, or 0.42%, to 24429.88.

Nvidia shares declined 2.9% to $150.96. Interim Chief Executive Colette Kress pointed to rising chip demand during Tuesday's earnings call as a sign that it was "business as usual" at the AI bellwether. She failed to allay investor doubts about the trajectory of the company and the tech sector as a whole in the absence of Huang, one of the driving forces behind AI.

Shares of some Nvidia partners, including CoreWeave, fell in the wake of the executive conference call. CoreWeave purchases graphics processing units from Nvidia so that it can stand up data centers and build a "cloud infrastructure" for AI companies. Nvidia also owns a stake in CoreWeave, which lost 4.1% to $47.83. One brokerage said Kress seemed to give the company wiggle room on plans to backstop data-center developers.

"Amidst questions of ecosystem support, Kress outlined on the call that support would remain 'disciplined and selective,' emphasizing closer counterparty scrutiny and identifying land, power and [data-center buildings] as 'the most important part of the financing that [they] would probably review,'" said credit strategists at brokerage Morgan Stanley, in a note to clients. "Tenant quality - or a credible...backstop - appears increasingly decisive in completing both smaller financings and large campuses."

The U.S. dollar rose to new 52-week highs after the minutes of the Federal Reserve's October meeting revealed central bankers' mounting inflation concerns.

Dollar-sensitive gold futures plunged $122, or 3.2%, to $3736.80 a troy ounce, their lowest closing value in more than a year. Copper futures slid 31.65 cents, or 5.3%, to $5.6595 a pound, closing at a seven-month low as strength in the greenback and a cloudy outlook for Chinese and data-center demand weighed on the red metal. That was copper's biggest loss since July 2025.

In one sign that inflationary pressure could ease in the coming weeks, oil futures continued their retreat, falling $2.75, or 3.2%, to $83.26 a barrel, the lowest close since August.

Treasury yields were mixed as risk aversion offset rate-hike anticipation.

The yield on the policy-sensitive two-year Treasury rose 0.011 percentage point to 4.798%. The yield on the 10-year Treasury note declined 0.036 percentage point to 5.065%. The yield on the 30-year bond slid 0.047 percentage point to 5.411%.

Economic data remained weak as the pending home sales index, which tracks home-sales contracts, decreased 4.7% to 63 in October, with activity slowing to levels not seen since the 2008-2010 housing crisis.

Anthropic was expected to price its initial public offering after the bell at more than $80 apiece, which would value the AI at roughly $1.5 trillion.

"It's exciting, but...let's remember the statistic that says something like 80% of IPOs over the last 10 years trade below their IPO price in the first 90 days and certainly SpaceX is a good example of that if you want to look at recent history," said Oliver Pursche, senior vice president at financial adviser Wealthspire. Pursche said the bigger question for Anthropic and the market as a whole is: "Are we going to see any meaningful regulatory changes as a result of the change in Congress?"

Chinese tech giant Tencent Holdings posted slower profit growth in the third quarter as its spending on AI infrastructure offset revenue gains.

Shares of UnitedHealth, CVS Health, and Humana each slid by 5% or more as investors weighed a federal proposal to expand Medicare Advantage audits along with a renewed push for Medicare for All.

Target shares rose 4% to $165.93 after the retailer posted its strongest quarterly sales increase in about five years, as price cuts lured inflation-weary consumers.

Shares of home-improvement chain Lowe's rose 1% to $222.78 after it boosted its growth outlook for the year due in part to tariff refunds.

Take-Two Interactive shares rose 6.2% to $216.61 after the videogame publisher's "Grand Theft Auto VI" received rave reviews from gamers who gained access ahead of the launch this week.

Egg producer Cal-Maine Foods said an avian flu outbreak at one of its Florida facilities would require the company to cull about 1.76 million birds.

data.title: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un inspected construction sites on Nov 17 and 18, KCNA says
data.description:
North Korean leader Kim Jong Un inspected construction sites in South Hamgyong Province on Tuesday and Wednesday, state media KCNA reported on Thursday.

His visit came as some analysts speculated he might meet US President Donald Trump on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen on Wednesday and Thursday.

On Wednesday, he also visited the Kim Jong Suk Naval University, KCNA reported.

The importance of the university is " remarkably increasing," Kim said, as the North Korean navy "is evolving into the high-tech service and multi-functional combined army branch."

A delegation led by a close aide to Kim returned by private plane on Wednesday after visiting Russia, KCNA also reported.

Jo Yong Won, a member of North Korea's ruling Workers' Party Political Bureau, met with Valentina Matvienko, chairwoman of the Federation Council of Russia, KCNA said, citing Russian media reports on Tuesday.

Matvienko told Jo that "Russia will always cherish the memory of bravery and heroism displayed by DPRK combatants," referring to the North Korean soldiers sent to Russia during the war in Ukraine, according to KCNA.

Jo also met with Russian President Vladimir Putin, KCNA reported on Wednesday.

data.description:
Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 18, 2026) - Jason Langrish, President, The Energy Roundtable Limited ("The Energy Roundtable"), and members of The Energy Roundtable team joined David Chelich, Sector Head, Global Energy and Diversified Industries, Toronto Stock Exchange ("TSX") and TSX Venture Exchange ("TSXV"), to close the market and celebrate the National Energy Roundtable Conference.

Founded in 2004, The Energy Roundtable is the private sector forum for defining the Canadian energy sector's role in domestic affairs and in global energy markets. Their policy roundtables and annual conference series in Toronto, Calgary, Houston and London gather energy sector leaders to advance the significant commercial opportunities that exist in Canadian energy.

The Energy Roundtable's market close takes place on the eve of the 11th annual National Energy Roundtable Conference. The event will gather six hundred leaders representing all aspects of the country's energy sectors for discussions on Canada's path to becoming a global energy superpower.

data.title: IC Group Holdings Inc. Named to the 2026 Deloitte Technology Fast 500
data.description:
Growth of 115% Driven by Recurring Revenue Expansion, Product-Market Fit of Core Solutions, and Growth Across All Three Business Segments.

Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 18, 2026) - IC Group Holdings Inc.  today announced that it has been named to the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™, a ranking of the 500 fastest-growing tech companies in North America. IC Group grew 115% from 2022 to 2025.

IC Group's President & CEO, Duncan McCready, said, "Being named to the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 is a strong endorsement of the growth we've delivered across all three of our business segments. That growth is a result of the product-market fit of our core solution across our business lines, the trust we've built with Fortune 500 companies and professional sports teams to deliver consumer engagement at scale, and great customers who push us to innovate every day. These fundamentals will help us continue to grow into the future. We're well positioned to keep building on them. "

About the 2026 Deloitte Technology Fast 500

Now in its 32nd year, the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 provides a ranking of the fastest-growing tech companies - both public and private - in North America. Technology Fast 500 award winners are selected based on percentage fiscal year revenue growth from 2022 to 2025.

In order to be eligible for Technology Fast 500 recognition, companies must own proprietary intellectual property or proprietary technology that significantly contributes to the company's operating revenues. Companies must have base-year (fiscal year 2022) operating revenues of at least US$50,000, and current-year (fiscal year 2025) operating revenues of at least US$5 million, with a growth rate of 50% or greater. Additionally, companies must be in business for a minimum of four years and be headquartered within North America (United States and Canada).

About IC Group

IC Group is a consumer engagement company driving commerce and data for global brands and professional sports teams across live events, digital ecosystems, and mobile channels. Operating at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce, we simplify the complexities of modern consumer engagement for customers on a global scale.

Agilent Technologies said it raised its quarterly cash dividend by 2.9%.
